articles.title: Anthropic plans to spend $518 billion on AI infrastructure. Pre-IPO perps barely blink.
articles.snippet: Anthropic's prospectus seen by Reuters shows big spending plans despite heavy losses. Still, pre-IPO perps barely moved on cryptocurrency exchanges.

articles.title: Traders aren't panicking yet despite cooling crypto sentiment
Caution builds in the bitcoin market even as prices stay well above summer lows
articles.snippet: Overall demand for leveraged exposure remains weak, marked by sliding futures open interest. The capital that's still in the market appears skewed toward bearish positions.

articles.title: ECB puts AI agent payments on the digital euro drawing board
articles.snippet: The ECB is seeking firms to explore AI agents and machine-to-machine interactions as it prepares a separate digital euro pilot for 2027.

articles.title: Canadian ‘crypto king’ set to represent himself at fraud trial
articles.snippet: Aiden Pleterski was allegedly behind a crypto Ponzi scheme between 2021 and 2022 that resulted in a kidnapping and related criminal charges.
